description:
Humans have been getting high for thousands of years. Ancient civilizations used mind-altering plants and chemicals for religion, warfare, medicine, and recreation.

The Greeks may have consumed a psychedelic version of kykeon during the secretive Eleusinian Mysteries. Viking berserkers may have used henbane to reduce pain and trigger rage. Ancient Egyptians mixed blue lotus with wine, while Scythians combined cannabis and opium in ritual ceremonies. Archaeologists have even found high-THC cannabis in a 2,700-year-old grave in China, suggesting people were deliberately cultivating stronger plants for their psychoactive effects.

Modern drug culture isn’t as modern as it seems. Humans have been experimenting with altered states for a very long time.
